source: Pew Research Center. 2012. "2011 National Survey of Mormons."
method: Population is all respondents (self-identified Mormons by the survey's own design), broken out by self-reported activity level in the Church (q406). q412 asks how often the respondent prays outside of religious services; this chart shows the top-two-box share praying at least once a day ("several times a day" + "once a day"). Don't know/refused is excluded from each row's denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
